The pooled breath turns, and returns, and turns again without being asked. Foundation. The method has room to grow in it now, and so does the road: the ferry crossing, and the outskirts of Old Ridge beyond it.
A woman waiting for the ferry asks whether anyone still sits in Fernhollow at dusk. Granny Shu, buying salt beside her, says nobody in particular and looks at you.
